messages:
Diana: Kicking off staggered region rollout for release v2.3.1 now. Order: US -> EU -> APAC. Pinning to text-gen-v2@2026-03-15. Any blockers?
Marco: thumbs up. Are warm pool numbers healthy in us-east?
deploy-bot: Deploy started: slice=us-east-1, version=text-gen-v2@2026-03-15, canary=5% 
Priyanka: APAC reserved capacity still warming (ap-southeast-1). I'll pre-warm 4 instances now.
Liam: US canary smoke: p95=120ms, errors=0.2%, token throughput stable.
ops-bot: Monitoring hooks added: release=v2.3.1, check=latency/errors, dashboard=https://redwood.ops/release/3745001234
Amanda: Hold policy: wait 10m stabilization per region. Rollback triggers: p95>300ms OR error_rate>1% sustained for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
Marco: Also add infra triggers: host CPU>80% or GPU temp>85C => abort and notify @eng-sre.
Diana: Note fallback plan: regional pin to text-gen-v1-quant@2025-11 if we hit rollback triggers.
Priyanka: EU canary scheduled in ~8m. KV cache prefetching enabled for EU region.
deploy-bot: EU canary started: slice=eu-west-1, canary=10%
Liam: EU smoke: p95=140ms, errors=0.5%. No obvious regressions.
Amanda: Holding APAC until EU stabilizes.
Priyanka: APAC pre-warm completed: 6/6 instances ready, warm pool +2 applied. Launching APAC canary 5%.
ops-bot: Traces tagged release/v2.3.1; alerting channel #incidents subscribed.
Marco: Reminder: change window 23:00-01:00 PST, keep human-on-call during that window.
Diana: If APAC fails, do NOT roll EU back automatically. Instead pin APAC to v1-quant and open incident.
deploy-bot: APAC canary metrics: errors spike to 2.3%, p95=360ms at 02:07 UTC -> holding rollout and notifying channels
Liam: Confirming hold. Starting rollback for ap-southeast-1 to pinned text-gen-v1-quant@2025-11 now.
Amanda: Opening incident with ENG-SRE, priority=P2, customer-impact=none. Adding runbook link.
Priyanka: Quick note: APAC had slower KV cache warmup; will add additional prefetch and increase initial cache TTL for next attempt.
ops-bot: Rollback complete for ap-southeast-1. Canary halted, routing back to pinned variant.
Diana: Thanks team. Postmortem items: (1) tune KV prefetch for APAC, (2) increase warm pool by 2 for ap-southeast, (3) add a telemetry flag to catch similar spikes earlier.
Marco: I'll be on-call for follow-up changes. Tagging @oncall-marco.
Diana: I'll update the release notes with a short summary and the rollback decision; schedule a follow-up deploy window after fixes.
Amanda: Closing thread once release notes updated and incident ticket created. :white_check_mark:
Diana: Closing — good job all.
